_derived: The head block that mainnet transaction a46244ab (tests/fixtures/tx_trx.json) referenced, rebuilt from its TAPOS fields. ref_block_bytes a63d are the low 16 bits of the height 0x0515a63d, and ref_block_hash 437d27f93863a488 is bytes 8..16 of the block id. The last 16 bytes of the block id are zeroed because a transaction records only those eight and this build never reads them. The timestamp is the transaction's own, which is what a wallet stamps from the head block it read.
